title: Browse Agent TaskScope
description: Declared before the first action of an agent session and shown to the user. PolicyEngine enforces it deterministically (ADR-005 §4). Stored in agent_sessions.scope_json.

origins.description: Origins the agent may navigate to and act on. Navigation elsewhere requires confirmation. Wildcards only for subdomains, e.g. `https://*.github.com`.

tools.description: Allow-list of tool names (from tool manifests).

profile.description: `isolated`: separate agent profile (default). `user_readonly`: the user's own profile but only read-only tools are allowed; PolicyEngine rejects the scope if any listed tool is not read_only.

session_imports.description: Origins whose session cookies the user agreed to copy into the isolated profile for this task only.

cross_origin_flows.description: Pre-approved data flows `from -> to` (e.g. copy prices from shop A to a comparison sheet on B). Anything else triggers confirmation.

observe_cross_origin_iframes.description: Iframe origins the sensor may include in observations (off by default).

money_limit_minor_units.description: 0 means the agent may never reach a payment step; any positive value still requires per-payment confirmation.

allow_cloud_planning.description: Permit cloud providers for planning over `public` observations only (ADR-007).

min_critic_tier.description: The critic may never be downgraded below this tier.
